4.purpose: S53-S54 with the new Thales: medium close-up before a dark crowd of helmeted silhouettes against the orange eclipse horizon; 0-2.2 s he studies the sky with quick eyes, tapping the shadow-stick on a hinged wooden wax tablet; 2.25-2.7 s he lowers his head with a slow blink; at ~2.75 his eyes meet the lens, his face squares to camera by ~3.2 s, and a sly, knowing half-smile with a slightly raised brow builds from ~3.25 s and holds to the end; slow push-in.
4.costume: Matches the new sheet: short curly hair with the thin fillet, trimmed curly beard, saffron himation with a dark woven border over an undyed chiton; hinged wooden tablet and a short stick (no staff).
4.identity: Reads as an Ionian philosopher, lively and amused, not saintly.
4.artefacts: None notable; a darker frame than take 3 (eclipse glow behind), the face well lit.
4.notes: Glance 187.65 -> 2.75 (-0.26 s); the old take 1 glanced at 2.80, so S53's keys barely move. No staff any more (marble.js takes 'his staff from the depth'): a short stick and the tablet.
